primaryRule: The main story should be understandable on first hearing by an attentive 9–10-year-old in India, without reducing the depth, cultural vocabulary, or source fidelity of the story. Simplify the delivery, not the idea.
provenanceRule: Provenance must always be available, but it does not always have to be spoken.
principles: retain meaningful Indian vocabulary with context
separate storyteller, source-scholar and editor voices
parent-only provenance outside the spoken lane by default
